species_seo.seo_title: 孔雀鱼怎么养？水温、pH与鱼缸要求 | AquaGuide
species_seo.meta_description: 孔雀鱼（Poecilia reticulata）饲养指南：适宜水温 18-28°C、pH 7.0-8.5、至少 40 升，并了解日常饲养重点。
species_seo.intro: 孔雀鱼（Poecilia reticulata）水族界的“百万鱼”，繁殖极快，喜欢弱碱性硬水，花色极其丰富。 建议水温 18-28°C、pH 7.0-8.5，鱼缸规格为至少 40 升。

species_seo.seo_title: 红绿灯怎么养？水温、pH与鱼缸要求 | AquaGuide
species_seo.meta_description: 红绿灯（Paracheirodon innesi）饲养指南：适宜水温 20-26°C、pH 5.0-7.0、至少 32 升，并了解日常饲养重点。
species_seo.intro: 红绿灯（Paracheirodon innesi）经典群游鱼，对温差较敏感，建议入缸前充分过水，水质稳定后极易养护。 建议水温 20-26°C、pH 5.0-7.0，鱼缸规格为至少 32 升。

species_seo.seo_title: 斑马鱼怎么养？水温、pH与鱼缸要求 | AquaGuide
species_seo.meta_description: 斑马鱼（Danio rerio）饲养指南：适宜水温 18-25°C、pH 6.5-8.0、至少 40 升，并了解日常饲养重点。
species_seo.intro: 斑马鱼（Danio rerio）著名的实验室用鱼，极其好养，游速快，具有很强的生命力和繁殖力。 建议水温 18-25°C、pH 6.5-8.0，鱼缸规格为至少 40 升。

species_seo.seo_title: 小精灵怎么养？水温、pH与鱼缸要求 | AquaGuide
species_seo.meta_description: 小精灵（Otocinclus vittatus）饲养指南：适宜水温 22-26°C、pH 6.0-7.5、至少 32 升，并了解日常饲养重点。
species_seo.intro: 小精灵（Otocinclus vittatus）最强草缸除藻工，只吃藻不伤虾，但对水质和氧气要求高，新缸容易饿死。 建议水温 22-26°C、pH 6.0-7.5，鱼缸规格为至少 32 升。

species_seo.seo_title: 一眉道人怎么养？水温、pH与鱼缸要求 | AquaGuide
species_seo.meta_description: 一眉道人（Sahyadria denisonii）饲养指南：适宜水温 15-25°C、pH 6.5-7.8、至少 120 升，并了解日常饲养重点。
species_seo.intro: 一眉道人（Sahyadria denisonii）群游效果震撼，游速极快且容易撞缸，需要高含氧量的环境和较大的游动空间。 建议水温 15-25°C、pH 6.5-7.8，鱼缸规格为至少 120 升。

species_seo.seo_title: 苹果螺怎么养？水温、pH与鱼缸要求 | AquaGuide
species_seo.meta_description: 苹果螺（Pomacea diffusa）饲养指南：适宜水温 20-28°C、pH 7.0-8.0、至少 30 升，并了解日常饲养重点。
species_seo.intro: 苹果螺（Pomacea diffusa）电商常见工具螺和观赏螺，能清理部分残饵和软藻。需要补钙和稳定水质，避免含铜药物。 建议水温 20-28°C、pH 7.0-8.0，鱼缸规格为至少 30 升。

species_seo.seo_title: 兰寿金鱼怎么养？水温、pH与鱼缸要求 | AquaGuide
species_seo.meta_description: 兰寿金鱼（Carassius auratus var. Ranchu）饲养指南：适宜水温 10-25°C、pH 7.0-8.0、至少 160 升，并了解日常饲养重点。
species_seo.intro: 兰寿金鱼（Carassius auratus var. Ranchu）无背鳍，游动缓慢。对水深敏感，不建议深水养殖，需注意预防失鳔病，喂食建议沉底。 建议水温 10-25°C、pH 7.0-8.0，鱼缸规格为至少 160 升。
species_seo.image_alt: 兰寿金鱼（Carassius auratus var. Ranchu）

species_seo.seo_title: 月光鱼怎么养？水温、pH与鱼缸要求 | AquaGuide
species_seo.meta_description: 月光鱼（Xiphophorus maculatus）饲养指南：适宜水温 20-28°C、pH 7.0-8.5、至少 48 升，并了解日常饲养重点。
species_seo.intro: 月光鱼（Xiphophorus maculatus）性格温和，体型圆润，有多种人工改良花色，适合作为混养缸的补充。 建议水温 20-28°C、pH 7.0-8.5，鱼缸规格为至少 48 升。

species_seo.seo_title: 珍珠马甲怎么养？水温、pH与鱼缸要求 | AquaGuide
species_seo.meta_description: 珍珠马甲（Trichopodus leerii）饲养指南：适宜水温 24-28°C、pH 6.0-8.0、至少 96 升，并了解日常饲养重点。
species_seo.intro: 珍珠马甲（Trichopodus leerii）性格极其温和，体表布满珍珠斑点，需要水草遮蔽物，是理想的混养缸主角。 建议水温 24-28°C、pH 6.0-8.0，鱼缸规格为至少 96 升。

species_seo.seo_title: 咖啡鼠怎么养？水温、pH与鱼缸要求 | AquaGuide
species_seo.meta_description: 咖啡鼠（Corydoras aeneus）饲养指南：适宜水温 22-27°C、pH 6.0-8.0、至少 56 升，并了解日常饲养重点。
species_seo.intro: 咖啡鼠（Corydoras aeneus）老牌入门鼠鱼，生命力顽强，适合清理缸底残渣，成群饲养更活泼。 建议水温 22-27°C、pH 6.0-8.0，鱼缸规格为至少 56 升。

species_seo.seo_title: 红剑鱼怎么养？水温、pH与鱼缸要求 | AquaGuide
species_seo.meta_description: 红剑鱼（Xiphophorus hellerii）饲养指南：适宜水温 20-28°C、pH 7.0-8.5、至少 96 升，并了解日常饲养重点。
species_seo.intro: 红剑鱼（Xiphophorus hellerii）雄鱼尾部有长剑状突起，跳跃能力极强，建议加盖养殖。 建议水温 20-28°C、pH 7.0-8.5，鱼缸规格为至少 96 升。

species_seo.seo_title: 玛丽鱼怎么养？水温、pH与鱼缸要求 | AquaGuide
species_seo.meta_description: 玛丽鱼（Poecilia sphenops）饲养指南：适宜水温 22-28°C、pH 7.0-8.5、至少 48 升，并了解日常饲养重点。
species_seo.intro: 玛丽鱼（Poecilia sphenops）食性杂，喜欢啃食水面油膜和藻类。对盐度耐受度高，水质波动大时易患白点病。 建议水温 22-28°C、pH 7.0-8.5，鱼缸规格为至少 48 升。

species_seo.seo_title: 圆尾斗鱼怎么养？水温、pH与鱼缸要求 | AquaGuide
species_seo.meta_description: 圆尾斗鱼（Macropodus ocellatus）饲养指南：适宜水温 4-26°C、pH 6.0-7.5、至少 64 升，并了解日常饲养重点。
species_seo.intro: 圆尾斗鱼（Macropodus ocellatus）中国斗鱼，耐寒能力极强。发色后带有金属蓝绿色。性格暴戾，同类间争斗严重。 建议水温 4-26°C、pH 6.0-7.5，鱼缸规格为至少 64 升。

species_seo.seo_title: 黑叉尾斗鱼怎么养？水温、pH与鱼缸要求 | AquaGuide
species_seo.meta_description: 黑叉尾斗鱼（Macropodus spechti）饲养指南：适宜水温 18-28°C、pH 6.0-7.5、至少 80 升，并了解日常饲养重点。
species_seo.intro: 黑叉尾斗鱼（Macropodus spechti）体色内敛沉稳，发色后尾鳍舒展非常优雅。相比普通叉尾，对水质的要求略高一点。 建议水温 18-28°C、pH 6.0-7.5，鱼缸规格为至少 80 升。

species_seo.seo_title: Guppy Care Guide | AquaGuide
species_seo.meta_description: Guppy (Poecilia reticulata) care guide: 18-28°C, pH 7.0-8.5, and at least 40 L tank size, with practical care notes.
species_seo.intro: Guppy (Poecilia reticulata) — A hardy livebearer known for rapid breeding and a wide range of colors. It prefers harder, mildly alkaline water. Recommended range: 18-28°C, pH 7.0-8.5, with a tank size of at least 40 L.

species_seo.seo_title: Neon Tetra Care Guide | AquaGuide
species_seo.meta_description: Neon Tetra (Paracheirodon innesi) care guide: 20-26°C, pH 5.0-7.0, and at least 32 L tank size, with practical care notes.
species_seo.intro: Neon Tetra (Paracheirodon innesi) — A classic schooling fish that is sensitive to sudden temperature changes. Care is easier once the aquarium is stable. Recommended range: 20-26°C, pH 5.0-7.0, with a tank size of at least 32 L.

species_seo.seo_title: Zebra Danio Care Guide | AquaGuide
species_seo.meta_description: Zebra Danio (Danio rerio) care guide: 18-25°C, pH 6.5-8.0, and at least 40 L tank size, with practical care notes.
species_seo.intro: Zebra Danio (Danio rerio) — A hardy, fast-swimming fish with strong adaptability and active behavior. Recommended range: 18-25°C, pH 6.5-8.0, with a tank size of at least 40 L.

species_seo.seo_title: Otocinclus Catfish Care Guide | AquaGuide
species_seo.meta_description: Otocinclus Catfish (Otocinclus vittatus) care guide: 22-26°C, pH 6.0-7.5, and at least 32 L tank size, with practical care notes.
species_seo.intro: Otocinclus Catfish (Otocinclus vittatus) — A planted-tank algae grazer that needs stable water and good oxygenation. New tanks may not provide enough natural food. Recommended range: 22-26°C, pH 6.0-7.5, with a tank size of at least 32 L.

species_seo.seo_title: Denison Barb Care Guide | AquaGuide
species_seo.meta_description: Denison Barb (Sahyadria denisonii) care guide: 15-25°C, pH 6.5-7.8, and at least 120 L tank size, with practical care notes.
species_seo.intro: Denison Barb (Sahyadria denisonii) — A very fast schooling fish that needs high oxygen levels and generous open swimming space. Recommended range: 15-25°C, pH 6.5-7.8, with a tank size of at least 120 L.

species_seo.seo_title: Mystery Snail Care Guide | AquaGuide
species_seo.meta_description: Mystery Snail (Pomacea diffusa) care guide: 20-28°C, pH 7.0-8.0, and at least 30 L tank size, with practical care notes.
species_seo.intro: Mystery Snail (Pomacea diffusa) — An ornamental and cleanup snail that can consume some leftover food and soft algae. Stable water and calcium availability are important, and copper-containing medications should be avoided. Recommended range: 20-28°C, pH 7.0-8.0, with a tank size of at least 30 L.

species_seo.seo_title: Ranchu Goldfish Care Guide | AquaGuide
species_seo.meta_description: Ranchu Goldfish (Carassius auratus var. Ranchu) care guide: 10-25°C, pH 7.0-8.0, and at least 160 L tank size, with practical care notes.
species_seo.intro: Ranchu Goldfish (Carassius auratus var. Ranchu) — A slow-swimming fancy goldfish without a dorsal fin. It is sensitive to water depth, and sinking food is recommended. Recommended range: 10-25°C, pH 7.0-8.0, with a tank size of at least 160 L.

species_seo.seo_title: Platy Care Guide | AquaGuide
species_seo.meta_description: Platy (Xiphophorus maculatus) care guide: 20-28°C, pH 7.0-8.5, and at least 48 L tank size, with practical care notes.
species_seo.intro: Platy (Xiphophorus maculatus) — A peaceful, rounded-bodied aquarium fish available in many selectively bred colors and suitable for community setups. Recommended range: 20-28°C, pH 7.0-8.5, with a tank size of at least 48 L.

species_seo.seo_title: Pearl Gourami Care Guide | AquaGuide
species_seo.meta_description: Pearl Gourami (Trichopodus leerii) care guide: 24-28°C, pH 6.0-8.0, and at least 96 L tank size, with practical care notes.
species_seo.intro: Pearl Gourami (Trichopodus leerii) — A gentle gourami with pearl-like spotting that benefits from planted cover and is suitable for peaceful community setups. Recommended range: 24-28°C, pH 6.0-8.0, with a tank size of at least 96 L.

species_seo.seo_title: Bronze Corydoras Care Guide | AquaGuide
species_seo.meta_description: Bronze Corydoras (Corydoras aeneus) care guide: 22-27°C, pH 6.0-8.0, and at least 56 L tank size, with practical care notes.
species_seo.intro: Bronze Corydoras (Corydoras aeneus) — A hardy beginner-friendly bottom-dwelling catfish that is more active when kept in a group. Recommended range: 22-27°C, pH 6.0-8.0, with a tank size of at least 56 L.

species_seo.seo_title: Swordtail Care Guide | AquaGuide
species_seo.meta_description: Swordtail (Xiphophorus hellerii) care guide: 20-28°C, pH 7.0-8.5, and at least 96 L tank size, with practical care notes.
species_seo.intro: Swordtail (Xiphophorus hellerii) — A livebearer whose males develop a sword-like tail extension. It is a strong jumper, so a covered aquarium is recommended. Recommended range: 20-28°C, pH 7.0-8.5, with a tank size of at least 96 L.

species_seo.seo_title: Molly Care Guide | AquaGuide
species_seo.meta_description: Molly (Poecilia sphenops) care guide: 22-28°C, pH 7.0-8.5, and at least 48 L tank size, with practical care notes.
species_seo.intro: Molly (Poecilia sphenops) — An omnivorous livebearer that may graze surface film and algae. It tolerates a range of salinity but can be sensitive to unstable water conditions. Recommended range: 22-28°C, pH 7.0-8.5, with a tank size of at least 48 L.

species_seo.seo_title: Roundtail Paradise Fish Care Guide | AquaGuide
species_seo.meta_description: Roundtail Paradise Fish (Macropodus ocellatus) care guide: 4-26°C, pH 6.0-7.5, and at least 64 L tank size, with practical care notes.
species_seo.intro: Roundtail Paradise Fish (Macropodus ocellatus) — A cold-tolerant paradise fish with metallic blue-green coloration when displaying. It can be highly aggressive toward its own kind. Recommended range: 4-26°C, pH 6.0-7.5, with a tank size of at least 64 L.

species_seo.seo_title: Black Paradise Fish Care Guide | AquaGuide
species_seo.meta_description: Black Paradise Fish (Macropodus spechti) care guide: 18-28°C, pH 6.0-7.5, and at least 80 L tank size, with practical care notes.
species_seo.intro: Black Paradise Fish (Macropodus spechti) — A dark-colored paradise fish with elegant finnage when displaying. It has somewhat higher water-quality requirements than common paradise fish. Recommended range: 18-28°C, pH 6.0-7.5, with a tank size of at least 80 L.
